subject.title: Reasoning effort can't be restored after selecting "off" on Claude Opus 4.7 (gateway rejects every non-off level with "use off")

question: For `github-copilot/claude-opus-4.7`, should the gateway accept the advertised explicit reasoning efforts, or should clients restore reasoning only by clearing the session override while treating the model as non-reasoning?
rationale: The client cannot safely infer the intended provider contract because `reasoning`, `supportedReasoningEfforts`, observed default behavior, and patch validation disagree.

options.title: Support clear/default state
options.body: Make clearing `thinkingLevel` a supported session operation, expose Default/Restore in clients, and advertise only explicit efforts the provider actually accepts.

options.title: Enable advertised efforts
options.body: Correct the model metadata and validator so every advertised Copilot Opus 4.7 effort is accepted and tested end to end.

options.title: Treat model as off-only
options.body: Remove the contradictory effort list and hide the picker, accepting that reasoning cannot be explicitly controlled for this provider/model.

recommendation.title: Support clear/default state
recommendation.body: Make clearing `thinkingLevel` a supported session operation, expose Default/Restore in clients, and advertise only explicit efforts the provider actually accepts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available target-side owner to coordinate the native client behavior with the gateway’s session/model contract.
